findings.evidence: Direct `python scripts/run_phase5b_prompt_rag.py --help` raises `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named src`.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Invoke script from repository root.
findings.required_correction: Add repository root before repository imports or expose package entry point.
findings.why_it_matters: Frozen runner is not executable through documented script form.

findings.changes_experimental_design_or_results: No; any prior mismatched run would be invalid.
findings.evidence: Caller-selectable config, prompt, QA, chunks, rankings, and trace selection are not checked against frozen hashes.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Supply alternate prompt/ranking paths and matching confirmation.
findings.required_correction: Resolve from frozen config and verify every file/request SHA before client creation.
findings.why_it_matters: Different experiment can run under nominal freeze confirmation.

findings.evidence: Caller chooses checkpoint; new path starts count at zero.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Repeat mode with second checkpoint path.
findings.required_correction: Use one canonical config-bound authorization ledger.
findings.why_it_matters: Hard request cap is resettable.

findings.evidence: Atomic replace does not lock read/check/increment/write across processes.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Start two processes against same ledger.
findings.required_correction: Use OS-level exclusive lock across reload, cap check, increment, and write.
findings.why_it_matters: Concurrent runners can dispatch twice while persisting one increment.

findings.changes_experimental_design_or_results: No; mixed run would be invalid.
findings.evidence: Full ledger starts without trace-returned modelVersion.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Trace returns A; later full first response B becomes full baseline.
findings.required_correction: Bind trace modelVersion into full approval and full ledger.
findings.why_it_matters: Trace and full rankings can come from different mutable stable-model versions.

findings.evidence: Free-tier artifact binds config hash, not credential/project context.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Confirm free project, then execute with another environment key.
findings.required_correction: Require same-session non-secret owner attestation and re-attestation on credential-context change; retain no credential identifier.
findings.why_it_matters: A billed credential could be substituted after attestation.

findings.evidence: Sanitized exceptions are raised `from exc`; provider body remains in `__cause__` and formatted tracebacks.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Format traceback from mocked APIError containing marker.
findings.required_correction: Raise sanitized exceptions `from None`; preserve only allowlisted class/status.
findings.why_it_matters: Generic logging can disclose provider error content.

findings.evidence: Response file writes before ledger success.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Crash between two lines and resume.
findings.required_correction: Use durable transaction states and recover hash-verified response without redispatch.
findings.why_it_matters: Crash/resume reissues valid request, then collides with existing output.

findings.evidence: Checkpoint validation omits complete schema, allowed logical IDs, completed-output existence, and state invariants.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Insert all plan IDs into completed list with count zero.
findings.required_correction: Validate strict state against frozen plan and reconcile every output hash.
findings.why_it_matters: Corrupt/forged checkpoint can silently skip calls and finalize incomplete run.

findings.evidence: Terminal failures discard prior retry history/raw invalid response; repeated 429 uses same collision-prone file.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Quota-stop twice across approved reset or exhaust transient retries.
findings.required_correction: Write append-only sanitized attempt events with unique IDs and raw-response metadata.
findings.why_it_matters: Failure audit contract is not preserved and resume can fail after network use.

findings.evidence: Runner does not enforce committed/clean freeze or explicit execution authorization.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Confirm free tier and invoke current uncommitted runner.
findings.required_correction: Require approved commit/tree, clean protected paths, and separate execution approval.
findings.why_it_matters: Dirty pending code can call provider.

findings.evidence: Repository does not install or runtime-check `google-genai[local-tokenizer]==2.13.0`.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Install project dependencies in clean environment and import module.
findings.required_correction: Add exact installable dependency/lock and startup version check.
findings.why_it_matters: Fresh checkout cannot import/test frozen client.

findings.evidence: Seven hashes stale; runner, evaluation protocol, free confirmation omitted; focused/full tests fail.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Run manifest hash test.
findings.required_correction: Regenerate complete manifest only after other fixes.
findings.why_it_matters: Offline freeze is not internally valid.

findings.evidence: Unvalidated query IDs become path components.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Use query ID containing `../`.
findings.required_correction: Enforce exact R5 IDs, canonical output root, and safe filename encoding.
findings.why_it_matters: Malformed IDs can escape output root.

findings.evidence: Previously exposed Gemini credential rotation is unverified.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Execute with still-exposed credential.
findings.required_correction: Revoke/replace and record dated non-secret rotation attestation.
findings.why_it_matters: Compromised credential may permit unauthorized quota use.

findings.changes_experimental_design_or_results: No current values; future forensic result may change from accepted to rejected.
findings.evidence: Per-query `results: []` passes; test covers empty run file only.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Provide every query with empty results arrays.
findings.required_correction: Reject empty result list per query and add fixture.
findings.why_it_matters: Malformed run silently receives zero metrics.

findings.evidence: Script references absent owner-approved R4 files; two hash targets unresolved.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Run freeze script against current pilot root.
findings.required_correction: Use preserved R4 candidate as source or add non-destructive lineage correction.
findings.why_it_matters: R5 freeze cannot be recreated from committed repository.

findings.changes_experimental_design_or_results: Likely trace only; ranking metrics unchanged.
findings.evidence: Equal-scoring windows retain FAISS return order because replacement is strict `>`.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Create equal-score windows from same chunk.
findings.required_correction: Tie-break equal window scores by ascending window ID.
findings.why_it_matters: Winning-window trace may vary despite deterministic ranking promise.

findings.evidence: CI outside equivalence margin is labelled `not equivalent`.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Use CI overlapping ±0.05.
findings.required_correction: Use `inconclusive`, preserving numerical CI.
findings.why_it_matters: Protocol requires inconclusive when interval touches/crosses boundary.

findings.evidence: Point-estimate sign becomes `improves` even when CI includes zero.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Inspect Hybrid−BM25 aggregate CI.
findings.required_correction: Label point-estimate direction and inconclusive inference.
findings.why_it_matters: Wording overstates inconclusive H4 evidence.

findings.evidence: Many tests assert existing artifact values/counts without independently recomputing from rankings/qrels.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Modify generator and artifacts together.
findings.required_correction: Add read-only independent per-query/aggregate recomputation tests.
findings.why_it_matters: Coherently wrong generated outputs may pass snapshot-style checks.

findings.evidence: Audit states 150 worst-case retry attempts while hard authorized caps total 50.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Compare aggregate worst case with mode caps.
findings.required_correction: Separate logical calls, authorized network-attempt maximum, and uncapped theoretical retry demand.
findings.why_it_matters: Token/call envelope terminology is internally ambiguous.

findings.evidence: Ranking validator does not resolve chunk IDs against frozen corpus.
findings.reproduction_or_failure_scenario: Insert unknown chunk in ranking.
findings.required_correction: Validate every ranked ID using chunk map.
findings.why_it_matters: Unknown IDs below pooling cutoff can be treated as irrelevant rather than rejected.

remaining_uncertainty: Free-tier credential/project binding remains procedural under no-identifier constraint.
Gemini raw response preservation is SDK serialization, not wire bytes.
verified_strengths: R5 remains AI-assisted/owner-authorized and qrels non-exhaustive.
Graph v3.2 and Hybrid deterministic contracts are strongly tested.
Prompt injection boundary, strict score parser, no fallback/backfill, and 429 stop are explicit.
